Thanks for the questionnaire, Jill — we reviewed it and can cover the majority of items in the kickoff. A few notes from infra/planning:

- Hosted vs Dedicated: for the POC hosted is fine; Dedicated only recommended if you need sustained high throughput or strict data isolation. We'll include quantization and caching guidance during the session to lower token costs.
- Temporary quota bump: we can provision a short-lived burst allowance. Proposal: host trial increase to 2x baseline burst capacity and a short-lived rate-limit of 30 RPS for the 10-minute peak windows. That should be sufficient for a 25 RPS peak plus headroom.
- Token budget: 200k tokens is fine. We'll monitor and abort early if we see anomalies.
- Prework: please share the prompt corpus (redacted) and one representative dataset for the test.

I've attached a quick rate-plan proposal (spreadsheet) outlining the bump and rollback timing.

Evelyn
